text: Before you quote a price or book a wellness visit, check whether the pet is a member. Members get covered services and member prices.
Remember: the Membership section on the pet's chart is the answer.
A red heart next to the name means Maple is on a plan.
The plan name is right under it.
In the household list, the heart shows which pets are members. Juniper has none.
Open the Membership section.
Here's Maple's plan, and its status: Active.
Benefits are available right away means the membership fee is paid.
Start and end dates, monthly or annual billing, the price, and the store discount.
And the card the membership is billed to.
What Maple can use lists each benefit, and how many are left.
Choose one means the options share one allowance, like these trip fees. Using any of them uses it up.
This one says Used, so another wellness visit this year is charged at the regular price.
Used this term shows what Maple has already had, and when.
Open the audit trail
to see each change to the membership: who did it, and when.
Now Juniper.
Juniper is not on a membership plan.
From here you can enroll her, or sign her up after a visit. Each has its own video.
The most common mistake is quoting from memory: what's left changes after every visit. Remember: the Membership section on the pet's chart is the answer.
